nodes.content: Enfour Memory combines FTS5 Porter lexical search and BGE-small dense embeddings using reciprocal rank fusion, then reranks at most sixty-four records with quantized GTE ModernBERT. Models run locally through fastembed with two ONNX inference threads. This quality-first profile was selected on LoCoMo development evidence retrieval before independent evaluation. Recall returns excerpts and evidence; ranking is not factual verification.
nodes.title: Local hybrid retrieval and reranking

nodes.content: Enfour Memory stores source-backed records, immutable revisions, typed relations, FTS5 and 384-dimensional embedding vectors in SQLite. WAL, FULL synchronization and optimistic revision checks protect updates. Exact vector scanning avoids a separate vector database for this small local deployment.
nodes.title: SQLite is the single memory store
